title: Spanish Turkey Mince Catalana
description: A hearty Spanish-inspired dish featuring ground turkey, roasted flavors, and a creamy twist.
instructions: In a large oven-safe skillet, heat the olive oil over medium-high. Add the diced onion and cook until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the ground turkey mince and cook until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the diced roasted red pepper and cook for an additional minute.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and cook for 15-20 minutes, or until the turkey is cooked through.
While the turkey cooks, prepare the Catalana sauce (see below for recipe).
Once the turkey is cooked, remove the skillet from the oven and stir in the Catalana sauce.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley.
